purpose: Out-of-sample model comparison; not a publication fit

selection_history.stage: Exploratory repeated cross-validation after inspection of a rejected candidate
selection_history.previous_decision: Rejected on original held-out test: grouped RMSE0.780787 to0.794891 and CRPS worsened
selection_history.independent_motivation: Fix unit marginal trait variances so declared cross-loadings and shared effort priors operate in comparable units; retain unrestricted LKJ correlations rather than assume positive common capability

original_dev_diagnostic.status: Canceled before results; superseded by decision to evaluate only three prespecified folds

selection_history.interpretation: Dataset and overlapping cells have already been inspected; these folds are correlated exploratory repeated CV, not untouched confirmation. Report every fold and preserve rejected candidate history.

numerical_settings.permitted_changes: Only additional draws/warmup/chains to resolve numerical diagnostics; no candidate retuning

selection_history.comparison_plan: Inspect equally weighted grouped RMSE/CRPS, pooled RMSE, matching-protocol effort ordering, coverage/width, and model-cluster uncertainty; report all folds, never select a favorable seed

leakage_controls: All efforts and sources of a model x benchmark held out together
Development and test rows both excluded from every training likelihood
No saved posterior, full-data initialization, or empirically fitted priors reused
Fresh held-out cell/family effects; learned model-family residuals discarded
Test outcomes must remain unopened until the candidate is fixed
limitations: Random connected-cell validation measures interpolation, not temporal generalization
Sparse models/benchmarks cannot be held out while retaining training connectivity
Interval calibration uses a count-to-logit delta approximation
Logit-named errors use declared transformed likelihood coordinates; money/time are log transforms and Arena is rescaled Elo
Pair ordering compares only matching benchmark, protocol, and effort class
These metrics validate benchmark prediction, not a unique definition of intelligence

correlated_unit.method: Paired model-cluster bootstrap over equally weighted model x benchmark group means
correlated_unit.direction: Candidate minus baseline; RMSE and CRPS lower is better, log density higher is better
correlated_unit.limitation: Benchmark errors may also correlate; intervals describe this fixed random split, not all future datasets

paired_comparison.direction: Candidate minus baseline; RMSE and CRPS lower is better, log density higher is better
